title: About That Iran Deal...
description:
Trump declared a historic deal with Iran. Iran released their own version with a $300 billion reconstruction plan and a full US withdrawal from the Persian Gulf. Nobody has published the actual text. A signing is set for Friday. Sixty days to figure out the details, including apparently whether Iran gets nukes or not. Nobody really knows what's happening.
